ideas.instructions: Have the stuffed animal greet each baby doll, then tuck them beside it for a pretend nap.
ideas.title: Cozy hello

ideas.instructions: Pretend the stuffed animal is taking the two baby dolls on a gentle journey; describe what they see along the way.
ideas.title: Bonnet journey

ideas.instructions: With your child, take turns choosing which baby doll the stuffed animal comforts first, and make up a kind bedtime story.
ideas.title: Caregiving story
